title: Data Mapping to Save Moms' Lives Act
official_summary:
Data Mapping to Save Moms' Lives Act

This act directs the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) to include data on maternal mortality and severe maternal morbidity in its broadband health mapping tool. This is an online platform that allows users to visualize, overlay, and analyze broadband and health data at national, state, and county levels.

The FCC must consult with the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention regarding the data to incorporate into the tool.

summary.headline: This law requires the FCC to add maternal health death and serious complication data to its online broadband health mapping tool.
summary.what_it_does: The law directs the Federal Communications Commission to include data on maternal mortality and severe maternal morbidity in its broadband health mapping tool. That tool is an online platform where users can view and compare broadband and health information at the national, state, and county levels. The FCC must consult with the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention about which data to add.
